column1: %1$s becomes the date and time of the save, %2$s the video's number on Facebook, %3$s who posted it and %4$s the day it was posted. What a save doesn't know is left out, and a name with none of these gets the date added. When the name is already in the folder, the time of the save goes on the end. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to use the default, %5$s.
column2: %1$s se convierte en la fecha y la hora del guardado, %2$s en el número del video en Facebook, %3$s en quien lo publicó y %4$s en el día en que se publicó. Lo que el guardado no sabe se omite, y a un nombre sin ninguno de ellos se le añade la fecha. Si el nombre ya está en la carpeta, se le añade al final la hora del guardado. Los caracteres no válidos se convierten en guiones bajos. Déjalo vacío para usar el nombre predeterminado, %5$s.

Save videos other apps can open
column2: Guardar videos que otras apps puedan abrir

column1: # context: summary of that switch; H.264, AAC, AV1 and WhatsApp are names and stay as they are

Saves videos as H.264 with AAC sound, which apps like WhatsApp accept. Facebook's sharpest version is often AV1, which some apps turn down, so a video can save at a lower quality. A video with no such version saves as usual.
column2: Guarda los videos en H.264 con sonido AAC, el formato que aceptan apps como WhatsApp. La versión más nítida de Facebook suele ser AV1, que algunas apps rechazan, así que un video puede guardarse con menor calidad. Un video sin esa versión se guarda como siempre.

Chats
column2: Chats

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; the card is Facebook's own "Get the Messenger app" card
Hide the Get Messenger card
column2: Ocultar la tarjeta para obtener Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name and stays as it is
The card at the top of Chats that asks you to get the Messenger app goes while Messenger is installed. Without Messenger it stays, so you can still install it from there.
column2: La tarjeta de la parte superior de Chats que te pide que descargues la app de Messenger desaparece mientras Messenger esté instalado. Sin Messenger, se queda para que puedas seguir instalándolo desde ahí.

Playback
column2: Reproducción

column1: # context: switch title; on, videos and music wait for a tap before they play
Tap to play
column2: Toca para reproducir

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Autoplay and Off are the name and value of Facebook's own setting, as Facebook shows them in this language
Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap before they play. Facebook's own Autoplay setting reads Off while this is on, and goes back to what you chose when it's off.
column2: Los videos, reels, historias y la música esperan a que toques antes de reproducirse. La opción de reproducción automática de Facebook aparece como desactivada mientras esto está activado y vuelve a lo que elegiste cuando lo desactivas.

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook; Marketplace is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Marketplace only
column2: Solo Marketplace

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the tab names are Facebook's own, as its tab bar shows them

The tab bar keeps Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu, and Facebook opens on Marketplace. Home with the news feed, Video, Friends and the other tabs go. Notifications and links still open where they lead.
column2: La barra de pestañas conserva Marketplace, Notificaciones y tu perfil o el Menú, y Facebook se abre en Marketplace. Inicio con el feed, Video, Amigos y las demás pestañas desaparecen. Las notificaciones y los enlaces siguen abriéndose donde apuntan.

Hide Upgrades
column2: Ocultar “Mejoras”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Settings and Help and support are Facebook's own Menu sections
The Upgrades section and its offers leave Facebook's Menu. Settings, Help and support and the rest of the Menu stay.
column2: La sección “Mejoras” y sus ofertas desaparecen del menú de Facebook. Configuración, Ayuda y soporte técnico y el resto del menú se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Also from Meta is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Also from Meta
column2: Ocultar “También de Meta”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the section links to Meta's other apps and shows ads for its devices
The Also from Meta section leaves Facebook's Menu, with its links to Meta's other apps and its ads for Meta's devices. Your own shortcuts stay.
column2: La sección “También de Meta” desaparece del menú de Facebook, con sus enlaces a las otras apps de Meta y sus anuncios de dispositivos de Meta. Tus propios accesos directos se quedan.

Search

column2: Ocultar Meta AI en la búsqueda

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Meta AI and Ask Meta AI are Meta's own names, as Facebook shows them

Search results lose the Meta AI answer and the Ask Meta AI prompts, and a suggestion no longer sends your search to Meta AI. People, groups, pages and posts stay, and the Meta AI button still opens Meta AI.
column2: Los resultados de búsqueda ya no muestran la respuesta de Meta AI ni las sugerencias para preguntarle a Meta AI, y una sugerencia ya no envía tu búsqueda a Meta AI. Las personas, los grupos, las páginas y las publicaciones se mantienen, y el botón de Meta AI sigue abriendo Meta AI.

The row of groups to join between posts, with its Discover more groups button. Posts from groups you're in stay.
column2: La fila de grupos para unirte entre las publicaciones, con su botón Descubrir más grupos. Las publicaciones de tus grupos se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Facebook's own header of a row of Stories from people you don't know, shown between posts
Hide "Stories you might like"

The row of Stories from people you aren't connected to that Facebook puts between posts. Your friends' Stories and the Stories tray stay.
column2: La fila de historias de personas con las que no tienes conexión que Facebook pone entre las publicaciones. Las historias de tus amigos y la bandeja de historias se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; trending videos Facebook sends as push notifications
Block trending video notifications
column2: Bloquear notificaciones de videos en tendencia

column1: # context: summary of that switch; reels are Facebook's short videos
Trending videos and the reels Facebook picked for you stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Los videos en tendencia y los reels que Facebook eligió para ti dejan de aparecer en tus notificaciones.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; memories are Facebook's posts from past years on the same day
Block memory notifications
column2: Bloquear notificaciones de recuerdos

column1: # context: summary of that switch; On this day is the name Facebook gives its memories feature
Facebook's "On this day" memories stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Los recuerdos de “Un día como hoy” de Facebook dejan de aparecer en tus notificaciones.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reminders of friends' birthdays
Block birthday notifications
column2: Bloquear notificaciones de cumpleaños

column1: # context: summary of that switch
No more reminders that it's a friend's birthday.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Block group and Page highlights
column2: Bloquear destacados de grupos y páginas

column1: # context: summary of that switch; creators are the people and Pages who post videos and posts you follow
Digests of what's going on in groups, Pages and creators you follow stop. Comments, replies and mentions still come through.
column2: Dejan de llegar los resúmenes de lo que pasa en los grupos, las páginas y los creadores que sigues. Los comentarios, las respuestas y las menciones siguen llegando.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; People you may know is Facebook's name for its friend suggestions, as in Hide "People you may know"
Block "People you may know"
column2: Bloquear “Personas que quizá conozcas”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; friend requests are other notifications, which always come through
Friend suggestions stop showing up in your notifications. Friend requests still come through.
column2: Las sugerencias de amistad dejan de aparecer en tus notificaciones. Las solicitudes de amistad siguen llegando.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; places near you and weather alerts Facebook sends
Block nearby and weather notifications
column2: Bloquear notificaciones de lugares cercanos y del clima

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Alerts about places near you and about the weather stop.
column2: Dejan de llegar los avisos sobre lugares cercanos y sobre el clima.

column1: # context: title of a note under Notifications, below the switches; what no switch there blocks
What always comes through
column2: Lo que siempre llega

column1: # context: text of that note; Android's own settings are the phone's per-app notification categories, which Facebook's server defines

Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions, calls and login alerts, and any kind Hushfacebook doesn't know. Android's own settings for Facebook's notification categories work too, since Facebook drops a notification whose category you turned off. Facebook's server decides which categories you get, though, so they may not split these kinds out.
column2: Los mensajes, las solicitudes de amistad, los comentarios, las menciones, las llamadas y las alertas de inicio de sesión, además de cualquier tipo que Hushfacebook no conozca. Los ajustes propios de Android para las categorías de notificaciones de Facebook también funcionan, porque Facebook descarta una notificación cuya categoría hayas desactivado. Pero es el servidor de Facebook el que decide qué categorías tienes, así que puede que no separen estos tipos.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; the stories Facebook suggests in the Stories tray from accounts you don't follow
Hide suggested stories
column2: Ocultar historias sugeridas

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Suggested is the label Facebook shows under such a story in the tray, and the tray reloads on its own schedule
Stories in the tray from people and Pages you don't follow, the ones marked Suggested. Your friends' stories and the Pages you follow stay. A change shows the next time Facebook loads the tray.
column2: Historias de la bandeja de personas y páginas que no sigues, las marcadas como sugeridas. Las historias de tus amigos y de las páginas que sigues se quedan. Un cambio se ve la próxima vez que Facebook carga la bandeja.

column1: # context: switch title under Marketplace; the ads Facebook puts between the things people sell in Marketplace's feed
Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
column2: Ocultar artículos publicitarios de Marketplace

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a boosted listing is one its seller paid Facebook to show to more people
Ads and boosted listings in Marketplace's feed. The other listings stay.
column2: Anuncios y artículos promocionados en el feed de Marketplace. Los demás artículos se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; hides posts whose text holds a word or phrase the person listed
Hide posts with words you choose
column2: Ocultar publicaciones con las palabras que elijas

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the keep list is the second list under it, and a settings file is the one Export settings writes

Posts whose text has a word or phrase from your list below. A post with a word from your keep list stays, and so does a post with no text. Your words only leave the phone in a settings file you export.
column2: Publicaciones cuyo texto tiene una palabra o frase de tu lista de abajo. Una publicación con una palabra de tu lista para conservar se mantiene, igual que una publicación sin texto. Tus palabras solo salen del teléfono en un archivo de configuración que exportes.

column1: # context: title of the row and dialog holding the list of words and phrases that hide a post
Words to hide
column2: Palabras para ocultar

column1: # context: title of the row and dialog holding the list of words and phrases that keep a post even when it has a word to hide
Words that keep a post
column2: Palabras que mantienen una publicación

column1: # context: message of the Words to hide dialog; %1$d is how many phrases a list holds (50), %2$d and %3$d the shortest and longest phrase in characters (2 and 60)
One word or phrase per line, up to %1$d, each %2$d to %3$d characters long. Capital letters don't matter, and a phrase matches anywhere in a post's text, inside longer words too.
column2: Una palabra o frase por línea, hasta %1$d, cada una de %2$d a %3$d caracteres. Las mayúsculas no importan, y una frase coincide en cualquier parte del texto de una publicación, también dentro de palabras más largas.

column1: # context: message of the Words that keep a post dialog; %1$d is how many phrases a list holds (50), %2$d and %3$d the shortest and longest phrase in characters (2 and 60)
A post with any of these stays, even when it also has a word to hide. One per line, up to %1$d, each %2$d to %3$d characters long.
column2: Una publicación con cualquiera de estas se mantiene, aunque también tenga una palabra para ocultar. Una por línea, hasta %1$d, cada una de %2$d a %3$d caracteres.

column1: # context: hint in the empty text box of both word list dialogs
One word or phrase per line
column2: Una palabra o frase por línea

column1: # context: toast after saving a word list, one line left out; %2$d and %3$d are the shortest and longest phrase in characters, %4$d how many a list holds
%1$d line was left out. A phrase needs %2$d to %3$d characters, one given twice counts once, and a list holds %4$d.
column2: Se omitió %1$d línea. Una frase necesita de %2$d a %3$d caracteres, una repetida cuenta una sola vez y una lista admite %4$d.

column1: # context: toast after saving a word list, several lines left out; %2$d and %3$d are the shortest and longest phrase in characters, %4$d how many a list holds
%1$d lines were left out. A phrase needs %2$d to %3$d characters, one given twice counts once, and a list holds %4$d.
column2: Se omitieron %1$d líneas. Una frase necesita de %2$d a %3$d caracteres, una repetida cuenta una sola vez y una lista admite %4$d.

No words yet.
column2: Todavía no hay palabras.

column1: # context: summary of a word list row holding one phrase
%1$d word or phrase.
column2: %1$d palabra o frase.

column1: # context: summary of a word list row holding several phrases
%1$d words or phrases.
column2: %1$d palabras o frases.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the list is Facebook's list of people to tag, and @ stays as it is
Facebook stops offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments. Typing @ still brings up the list, and what you wrote is never changed.
column2: Facebook deja de ofrecerte personas para etiquetar mientras escribes palabras normales en publicaciones y comentarios. Si escribes @, la lista sigue apareciendo, y lo que escribiste nunca cambia.
